source.title: Dragonflight source-original ore and herb processing ledger search

notes: New name-first queries this run across Reddit, Blizzard, Wowhead, GitHub, Method, profession guides and Warcraft Wiki did not produce any unindexed original rank-specific refund-aware per-material 0-N event ledger. Existing Bugy, Jallfo, Xenastro, Aary and superbondez original source cohorts were not recopied. This searched row is not a measured zero and cannot be used for any drop probability.
lookingFor: Dragonflight Draconium 189143/188658, Serevite 190394/190395/190396, Khaz'gorite and Prismatic 194545 prospecting and Bubble Poppy 191467 / Saxifrage 191464/191465/191466 milling: independently sourced actual casts, refunds, output IDs and 0-N histograms.
whereLooked: Reddit r/woweconomy by name: 'Draconium Ore prospecting casts spreadsheet': historical Jallfo and Xenastro cohorts already indexed; no new per-output zero-inclusive events.
US Blizzard forums by name: 'Serevite Ore prospecting results casts Resourcefulness': no new verified raw completed-cast ledger.
Wowhead by name: 'Khaz'gorite Ore prospecting Illimited Diamond 20 casts': previously indexed anecdotes and Bugy source tables.
Wowhead by name: 'Prismatic Ore prospected 400 80 prospects': superbondez original already indexed, no novel output-hit series.
Reddit r/woweconomy by name: 'Bubble Poppy milling pigment results': no independent refunded-operation 0-N histogram.
Wow-Professions by name: 'Saxifrage milling sample yield': guide correlations, not original per-cast observations.
